propositions: A new advisory container criterion 'decomp-shape' must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED) with facet 'container' and added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA list to audit decomposition-shape smells.

The criterion detects two decomposition anti-patterns: layer-cake splits (partitioned by architectural layer instead of vertical slices) and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge (child names/consumes sibling output with no ordering dependency).

The criterion is routed as advisory-posture (never blocking) through criteria_routing.json with exec:AGENT, facet:container, scope:[container], and block_threshold:0.95; blocking promotion is deferred until E6 order-stability clears floor (fleiss_kappa ≥ 0.6).
The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria via pass1_container when a fixture carries a children: list, enabling bounded sanity testing without E2/E3 corpus batch-eval.

Bounded sanity fixtures (4 hand-authored cases: layer-cake and consumed-artifact positives, vertical-slice and ordered negatives) must achieve recall 1.0 on positives and false-accept 0.0 on negatives with stability 1.0.

The criterion auto-flows into the standing effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py) with zero per-criterion wiring, and promotion-gate prerequisites (dogfood effectiveness + E6 order-stability floor) are documented.
